main_text.p: שְׁלִיחָא, שְׁלִיחָא Ch. & Syr. Missus, legatus, nuncius; Apostolus: Nudus, nudatus. Plural. שְׁלִיחִין Legati, missi: Nudi, nudati, Act.19.16.
שְׁלִיחוּתָא, שְׁלִיחוּתָא Ch. & S. Missio, Legatio, Apostolatus. תּוּשְׁלְחְתָּא Ch. Idem, Judic.5.15.
שְׁלַח Pahel Ch. Mutare, commutare, permutare. Quadratum ex verbo חָלַף, per transpositionem litterarum ל, & ח, pro שְׁחַלַּף ut Syr. Ithpah. אִשְׁתַּלְחַף Mutari, commutari.
שְׁלְחוּפִי Ch. Pro, Vice, ut Hebr. חָלַף & Ch. חֲלוּפִי, Proverb. 21. v. 8.
שְׁלַט Ch. & Syr. Dominari, dominium, potestatem exercere, habere: Succumbere in coitu, Levit.18.23. & 20.16. Ithpeh. אִשְׁתַּלַּט Idem, Prov.17.2.

Pahel שַׁלַּט Idem. Ethpah. Syr. Idem, ad Rom.6.9.1. ad Cor.6.12. Aphel אַשְׁלֵיט Idem: Item Dominari facere, dominium concedere, dominatorem facere vel constituere, dominari sinere, copiam vel potestatem facere.

שְׁלִיט Chald. & Syr. Dominus, Dominator, Princeps, Dynasta, potestatem, copiam habens, לָא שְׁלִיט Non copiam habens, Esrae 7.24. Hinc Syr. Licitum est, Licet, Licitum est in Sabbatho, Mar.3.4. Non licet, Illicitum. Plural. שְׁלִיטִין Dominatores: Foemin. 1. ad Corinth. 7.4.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words are printed in their own scripts; the transcription above renders them approximately and is not certain letter by letter. Syriac words in the printed Syriac script (e.g. after "Syr. Exspoliatio" and "Syr. Idem") are shown here only as placeholders for the original characters and should be checked against the scan.
